declarations.name: currencyDigits
declarations.description: Fraction digits of a currency's minor unit (2 for EUR, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD).

Two linked amount and currency fields, the way Wise and Revolut quote a transfer: the reader types what they send or
what the recipient gets, and the other side is computed from `rate`, after `fee`. A swap button exchanges the two
currencies, and a guaranteed rate (`rate-expires`) counts down beside the rate, then asks for a new one.

It is built from two `c2-money-input`s, so typing, the locale's grouping, pasting and the currency pickers are
theirs, and amounts are integers in **minor units** as there (`amount="100000"` in EUR is €1,000.00): no amount
passes through floating point, only the rate. `fixed` says which field `amount` belongs to: `from` (the default)
computes the recipient's amount as `(amount − fee) × rate`; `to` computes what to send as `amount ÷ rate + fee`,
rounded up so the recipient gets at least that much. Each currency rounds to its own minor unit (JPY has none).

A swap cannot know the reverse quote, so the component shows `1 ÷ rate` marked as indicative and fires `swap`: the
app then sets the real `rate`. When a guaranteed rate runs out, the computed amount dims, `rate-expire` fires, and a
"New rate" button takes the swap button's place and fires `rate-refresh`; setting `rate` or `rate-expires` again
clears it. A picked currency fires `currency-change`, the cue to fetch a rate for the new pair.

`input` and `change` carry the whole state (`{ from, to, fromAmount, toAmount, fixed, rate }`) and bubble like any
field's; the converter is not form-associated, so read the amounts from that detail or from `fromAmount` and
`toAmount`. The computed amount is announced to screen readers once typing pauses.

cssProperties.description: Space between the fields and the lines.
cssProperties.name: --c2-fx-converter--gap

cssProperties.description: The amounts in the two fields.
cssProperties.name: --c2-fx-converter__amount--font-size

cssProperties.description: The line the fee and rate lines hang from.
cssProperties.name: --c2-fx-converter__rail--border

cssProperties.description: The computed amount while the rate has expired.
cssProperties.name: --c2-fx-converter__stale--opacity

members.name: from
members.description: The currency sent.

members.name: to
members.description: The currency received.

members.name: currencies
members.description: Currencies both pickers offer, as a `;` list. A picker shows with two or more.

members.name: fromCurrencies
members.description: Currencies the upper picker offers, when they differ from `currencies`.

members.name: toCurrencies
members.description: Currencies the lower picker offers, when they differ from `currencies`.

members.name: amount
members.description: The amount typed, in minor units of its field's currency; empty for none.

members.name: fixed
members.description: The field `amount` belongs to; the other is computed.

members.name: rate
members.description: 1 unit of `from` buys `rate` units of `to`. 0 (unknown) leaves the computed field empty.

members.name: fee
members.description: The fee, in minor units of `from`, taken before converting. Set, it draws the fee lines.

members.name: rateExpires
members.description: When a guaranteed rate runs out: an ISO time or epoch milliseconds. The rate line counts down to it.

members.name: max
members.description: The most that can be sent, in minor units of `from`: above it, the upper field shows an error.

members.name: fromLabel
members.description: The label of the upper field. Default: "You send".

members.name: toLabel
members.description: The label of the lower field. Default: "Recipient gets", or "Recipient gets exactly" once typed in.

members.name: locale
members.description: The locale amounts are formatted in. Without it: the nearest `lang`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns off both fields and the swap button.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Shows the amounts without letting them be edited or swapped.

members.name: left
members.description: Seconds left on the guaranteed rate, or `undefined` without one.

members.name: span
members.description: The guarantee's length when it was set, for the ring.

members.name: swapping
members.description: The inverted rate the swap button set, until the update that draws it.

members.name: picking
members.description: A currency picked in a field: the `input` that follows it is the picker's, not the reader's typing.

members.name: fromAmount
members.description: The amount sent, in minor units of `from`.

members.name: toAmount
members.description: The amount received, in minor units of `to`.

members.name: value
members.description: The state `input` and `change` carry.

members.name: amounts
members.description: Both amounts: the typed one as given, the other computed. Empty strings where there is nothing to show.

members.name: tick
members.description: Counts the guarantee down; at zero, marks the rate expired and fires `rate-expire` once.

members.name: stopInner
members.description: The field enrols in a `c2-form-field` and fires `input`/`change` of its own: the converter speaks for both.

members.name: formatMoney
members.description: An amount in minor units as "1,079.72 USD".

events.name: rate-expire
events.description: Fired when the guaranteed rate runs out. Does not bubble.

events.name: input

type.text: CustomEvent<{ from: string; to: string; fromAmount: string; toAmount: string; fixed: 'from' | 'to'; rate: number }>

events.description: Fired on every edit, with the computed amount already updated.

events.name: change

type.text: CustomEvent<{ from: string; to: string; fromAmount: string; toAmount: string; fixed: 'from' | 'to'; rate: number }>

events.description: Fired when an edit is committed, a currency is picked, or the currencies are swapped.

events.name: currency-change
events.description: Fired when the reader picked a currency in either field. Does not bubble.

events.name: swap
events.description: Fired when the swap button exchanged the currencies; set the new `rate`. Does not bubble.

events.name: rate-refresh
events.description: Fired when the reader asks for a new rate after it expired. Does not bubble.
